title: How a Cactus Saves Water
bigQuestion: How does a cactus live in a dry desert?
paragraphs: A cactus lives in a hot, dry desert. Its thick stem stores water for a long time. A waxy skin keeps water from escaping. Tiny spines protect the plant from hungry animals. These features help the cactus survive with very little rain.

questions.prompt: Which sentence fits the whole article?

options.A: A cactus has features that help it save water.
options.B: A cactus needs lots of rain.
options.C: A cactus grows in the ocean.
